{"id":2056355165,"question_id":4356,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 weeks, 4 days","timestamp":1783219198,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2056355165/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sum of Integers with Maximum Digit Range","memory":"30.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int digitrange(int x)\n    {\n        int mx = 0 , mn = 9;\n        while(x){\n            int d = x % 10;\n            mx = max(mx , d);\n            mn = min(mn , d);\n            x /= 10;\n        }\n        return mx - mn;\n    }\n    \n    int maxDigitRange(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int maxrange = 0;\n        for(auto it : nums){\n            maxrange = max(maxrange , digitrange(it));\n        }\n        int sum = 0;\n        for(auto it : nums){\n            if(digitrange(it) == maxrange) sum += it;\n        }\n        return sum;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sum-of-integers-with-maximum-digit-range","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2297}
